What kind of product would you like to sell in the said country?
Who are the people who’d be your early adopters for the new collection?
Who you’d sell the product to?
How much you’d like to make from the product (cost & profit margins)?
How would you sell amidst competitors who have been around much longer than you?
Who are your competitors? How long have they been around in the market? What kind of business plan and branding strategy do they have?
How long would you take to score a deal with the local partners?
What your goals are to scale?
How would you like your new customers to perceive you as a brand?
Finally, ask “What If” questions to envision how this innovation will handle the challenges of the future.
